Connections that drive true transformation.

Real progress happens when the right things come together: expertise and data, insights and human ingenuity, the physical and the digital. At Honeywell Technologies, we make these connections real, turning isolated intelligence into coordinated action.

Expertise earned over a century.

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.

Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

Autonomy grounded in partnership.

Autonomy isn't a switch we flip. It's a journey taken together. We build on the control systems customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes improvements, and acts only with their approval.

Wer wir sind

Wenn es auf die zuverlässige Übertragung von Daten, Signalen und Strom ankommt, ist ODU Ihr Partner für leistungsstarke Steckverbinder und Verbindungslösungen.

Unsere Systeme kommen weltweit in der Medizintechnik, Militär- und Sicherheitstechnik, Mess- und Prüftechnik, Industrie, Robotik sowie im Automotive-Bereich zum Einsatz – auch unter anspruchsvollen Umgebungsbedingungen.

Von Rundsteckverbindern und modularen Steckverbindern über elektrische Kontakte bis hin zu komplett konfektionierten und kundenspezifischen Systemlösungen bieten wir mit 80 % Fertigungstiefe alles aus einer Hand.

So profitieren Sie von höchster Qualität, kurzen Entwicklungswegen und einer individuell auf Ihre Anwendung abgestimmten Verbindungslösung.

From repeatable torque wrenches to excellent torque measurement devices, energy-saving cordless impulse screwdrivers, and process-controlled screwdriving systems to individual special tools made to order. Our high-class product line precisely addresses the tools preferred in industrial manufacturing. The renowned brand-name tools have been used successfully for decades in mechanical engineering, in the production of vehicles and conveyors, in the aerospace industry, as well as in plastics processing, electrical appliance manufacturing, and numerous other branches of industry.

 

Strong Brands – Strong Partners

 

  • STURTEVANT RICHMONT (US) 
    Torque wrenches, torque screwdrivers and torque testers from the established US industry leader have been impressing customers for over eight decades (aka 'TORQ-X-PERTS'). Their unrivalled durability, exceptional robustness and lasting accuracy are legendary. Sturtevant Richmont has been certified to ISO-9001 since 2001 and has been accredited to ISO-17025 in the field of torque calibration since 2003. We have been Sturtevant's sole authorised sales and service partner in German-speaking countries (D-A-CH) since 1987. Only at ZEMO can you obtain the world's best torque tools directly from the German importer.

 

  • YOKOTA Industrial (JP)
    High-performance Hi-Tec impulse tools and documenting EC fastening systems from the Japanese specialist have proven themselves in industrial applications worldwide. Yokota is ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified. We also offer maintenance, repair and calibration services, as well as suitable power sockets, screwdriver bits and industrial-quality air line and handling accessories.

 

  • CRANE Electronics (UK) 
    Excellent torque measurement technology from the renowned Crane Electronics ensures quality-assured assembly results. Crane is ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified and ISO-17025 accredited. Since 1995 we have been Crane's sales partner for high-precision rotating or static torque transducers and data collectors, intelligent torque spanners and, last but not least, bolting simulators.

 

  • TOHNICHI (JP)
    We also stock selected torque products from the renowned Japanese manufacturer Tohnichi, which offers high-quality solutions for very low to very high torques in particular, such as colour-marking torque wrenches, radio-controlled screwdrivers and dial gauges. Focussing on screw tightening control from the outset, Tohnichi developed its first torque spanner in 1951. Tohnichi is also ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified.

  • MOUNTZ (US)
    The latest addition to our range of high-quality torque tools comes straight from the birthplace of innovation, California's Silicon Valley. Developed with the legendary precision, accuracy and safety that continue to steer the world of manufacturing in one direction: forwards. Mountz products are built to last and rigorously tested to meet the highest standards. Mountz is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017 certified company. Selected torque screwdrivers and torque spanners now available at ZEMO.

 

Safe and Reliable Pneumatic Pliers 

 

Pneumatically operated cutting, severing, punching, or crimping machines, etc., significantly simplify and accelerate repetitive and/or labor-intensive work processes. Based on decades of experience in industrial and commercial applications, we design high-quality pneumatic pliers in Hamburg. For decades, we have been designing and manufacturing high-quality pneumatic pliers for industrial or commercial applications in Hamburg according to individual customer specifications.
